data.narrative:
Bravo Ordnance is a Seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $3.6M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables in Defense & Security, supplemented by a broader universe of 10 total peers (2 public, 8 private) including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $3.6M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next stage, implying a valuation of $9M. Peer-median analysis draws from four direct comparables spanning Seed and Series A stages—Stark Defence ($4.0B), UFORCE ($1.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M)—yielding a median valuation of $700M, with a range of $125M to $4.0B.

The wide spread between methods reflects asymmetric comparable valuations typical of early-stage defense tech, where funding environments and technical differentiation drive substantial variance. The triangulated analysis supports a range of $8M to $805M, with a median of $354M. Given Bravo's Seed stage and capital raised, the lower bound ($8M) aligns with stage mechanics, while the median and upper bound reflect peer set composition skewed toward later-stage and well-funded competitors. Key uncertainties include revenue, customer pipeline, and technical defensibility relative to the peer set.
